help: What it does This tool provides several loss, score, and utility functions to measure classification performance. Some metrics might require probability estimates of the positive class, confidence values, or binary decisions values. This tool is based on sklearn.metrics package. For information about classification metric functions and their parameter settings please refer to Scikit-learn classification metrics.

options: Text report of the main classification metrics
F1 score (aka balanced F-score or F-measure)
Compute precision, recall, F-measure and support for each class
Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) for binary classes
Confusion matrix (evaluate the accuracy of a classification)
Precision-recall pairs for different probability thresholds
Log loss (aka logistic loss or cross-entropy loss)
Area Under the Curve (AUC) from prediction scores
